diagrams.title: Expense Validation & Constraint Traceability
diagrams.description: Traceability map linking functional requirements and constraints to the Expense entity.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Requirements
        RULE-AMT-POS["RULE-AMT-POS: Amount must be positive"]
        RULE-DATE-ISO["RULE-DATE-ISO: Valid ISO date, no future dates"]
        CONST-STATE["CONST-STATE: Only Create/Delete supported"]
    end

    subgraph DataModel
        ENT-EXPENSE["ENT-EXPENSE: Expense Entity"]
    end

    RULE-AMT-POS -->|relates_to| ENT-EXPENSE
    RULE-DATE-ISO -->|relates_to| ENT-EXPENSE
    CONST-STATE -->|relates_to| ENT-EXPENSE

diagrams.title: Expense Creation Workflow
diagrams.description: Logic flow for creating an expense, incorporating the extracted validation rules.
diagrams.mermaid_code:
flowchart TD
    START[Start]
    INPUT[Input Expense Data]
    DEC1{"Is amount > 0?"}
    DEC2{"Is date valid ISO & not future?"}
    SAVE[Save ENT-EXPENSE]
    ERR_AMT[Error: Invalid Amount]
    ERR_DATE[Error: Invalid Date]
    END[End]

    START --> INPUT
    INPUT --> DEC1
    DEC1 -- "No" --> ERR_AMT
    DEC1 -- "Yes" --> DEC2
    DEC2 -- "No" --> ERR_DATE
    DEC2 -- "Yes" --> SAVE
    ERR_AMT --> END
    ERR_DATE --> END
    SAVE --> END
